title: Seven Years on Mirrorless, One Week Back on a DSLR
excerpt: Seven years on mirrorless, one week back on a DSLR. The return trip is the clearest lesson yet in what your mirrorless camera is actually doing for you.

title: Zooms Won the Lens Charts. Here Is What That Means for Your Next Lens
excerpt: Nine of the ten best-selling lenses in Japan are zooms, and the breakout is Sigma's new 50-120mm f/2.8 for APS-C. Versatility is what photographers actually buy.

title: Sigma's 85mm f/1.2 Is So Clean People Think It's AI
excerpt: Sigma's 85mm f/1.2 is so clean that non-photographers keep asking if the portraits are AI. The lesson is not about sharpness. It is about what makes a photo feel real.
